text: Direct provider-native four-face LegacyTriangle tetra reproduction has valid colored 16x4 atlas, bounded UVs and finite normals but zero chromatic output. Reproduces stock OpenJFX21 and frozen PLS OpenJFX24 with affineAtlas flag both false/true; sampler toggle is not a repair. Initial planar control was visually invalid (edge-on, blank white) and is being corrected to Dorsal before interpretation. No production change or acceptance waiver. Existing 320d CI focused lane passed; full and coverage still pending.
